visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor space, smiling and speaking directly into the camera. She wears a grey knit cardigan. (2) The camera cuts to a retail display for 'Little PETIT', featuring pink and white cylindrical pedestals showcasing various small nail polish bottles and decorative graphics. (3) A macro close-up depicts a finger being painted with a dark blue-grey liquid. (4) A series of close-up shots show a person's hand peeling a thin, elastic film of dried nail polish off several fingernails of different colors including dark blue, pink, and glitter gold. (5) A row of colored nail polish bottles appears, followed by a red bottle centered in front of a red graphic circle with the text '70% water'. (6) The woman returns to the frame, holding a red bottle of nail polish and smiling cheerfully. (7) Finally, she is seen standing next to the retail counter, gesturing towards the products with an open hand, inviting viewers to explore.
